body: A framework for building AI agents and applications with language models, tools, and data sources.
plain_description: **Build AI assistants and agent-powered applications with LangChain.** Connect language models to data, tools, and other services. Swap models and refine workflows as your needs change.
technical_description: LangChain is a Python framework for building agents and LLM-powered applications. It provides interoperable components and integrations for models, embeddings, vector stores, retrievers, and tools, with abstractions for composing and customizing application workflows.
title: LangChain
